findings.title: Preview search query "docker compose" does not expose the expected search scopes
findings.details: Preview scopes Docs do not match production scopes Docs, Integrations, Self Hosting, FAQ & Guides, All, GitHub for "docker compose". Missing on preview: Integrations, Self Hosting, FAQ & Guides, All, GitHub.

findings.title: Preview search query "docker compose" returns no real client-side results
findings.details: Preview only surfaced 1 option(s) and emitted GraphQL warnings, while production surfaced 3 option(s) for the same query.
